About the Position

This Canterbury project examines advanced manufacturing approaches for restoring ageing bridges and improving their performance. The research combines civil infrastructure questions with manufacturing methods, supported by a three-year project scholarship.

Research Areas

  • Civil engineering
  • Advanced manufacturing
  • Bridge restoration

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 32,650/year plus tuition
DurationThree years
Research expensesUp to NZD 5,000 over the degree, separate from the annual stipend

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsThree-year project; engineering and manufacturing research.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round27 October 2026
LocationNew Zealand

About University of Canterbury

Canterbury offers doctoral study and university-funded scholarships in Christchurch. Applicants can seek general doctoral funding or compete for scholarships linked to a particular research project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/uc-graduate-school/future-research-students/research-projects/advanced-manufacturing-methods-for-restoration-and-performance-o

Source: canterbury.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 27 October 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 27 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

English language requirements

University of Canterbury requires evidence of English proficiency for international PhD admission: IELTS Academic with an average of 6.5 and no band below 6.0 is the standard route, alongside a limited set of alternatives such as TOEFL iBT 90 or prior study in an approved English-speaking education system.
